hunt.justification: AD RMS protects critical enterprise intellectual property. The non-rotatable SLC private key makes the discovery of this infrastructure a high-risk precursor to document theft that can persist for decades.

scenario.summary: An attacker performs reconnaissance on an Active Directory Rights Management Services (AD RMS) deployment to identify the cluster root, service endpoints, and rights-policy templates. This discovery phase maps the trust model and identifies the AD RMS Service Group as a high-value target for subsequent credential extraction.

meta.rationale: The hunt begins by identifying hosts with AD RMS installed via hb_software_inventory to create a focused scope for HTTP and DNS monitoring.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is mapping the Active Directory Rights Management Services (AD RMS) deployment by enumerating its SOAP endpoints and identifying rights-policy templates from an unprivileged domain account.

blind_spots.risk: If HTTP logging is only at the perimeter, internal-to-internal enumeration of the RMS cluster will be invisible.
blind_spots.question: Was the 401 response generated by IIS or a proxy?
blind_spots.requires: hb_http_activity from the web server itself
blind_spots.remediation: Enable and collect IIS logs from the AD RMS cluster servers.

blind_spots.risk: AD RMS publishes an SCP in AD; unprivileged users can query this via LDAP to find the cluster URL without using DNS or scanning.

blind_spots.remediation: Collect and monitor LDAP query telemetry for SCP object classes.

hunt.name: AD Rights Management Service Reconnaissance
hunt.description: This hunt targets the reconnaissance phase of an AD RMS attack. AD RMS uses SOAP over HTTP/HTTPS for client operations (certification, licensing) and administration. Because the client pipeline endpoints are open to all domain users, an adversary can discover the cluster and its templates before attempting to reach the gated administrative surface. We first identify the servers hosting the RMS role, then parallel-check for SOAP enumeration (specifically 401s on admin paths), rare user access patterns, and DNS discovery of the cluster infrastructure.

coverage.reason: Local group membership enumeration on member servers (e.g., via SAMR/LSARPC) is not captured in the provided telemetry surfaces.

nodes.label: Inventory hosts with AD RMS installed

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, vendor_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%rights management%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%ad rms%')
config.description: Identify the hosts in the estate that have the Active Directory Rights Management Services role or software installed to scope subsequent queries.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames hosting the RMS role. If empty, the role may be installed but not captured in software inventory, or not present.

primitive_config.label: Inventory hosts with AD RMS installed
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, vendor_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%rights management%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%ad rms%')
primitive_config.expected: A list of hostnames hosting the RMS role. If empty, the role may be installed but not captured in software inventory, or not present.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name, url_path, status_code, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/wmcs/%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY time DESC
config.description: Identify accounts attempting to reach gated administrative endpoints (/admin) or the client pipeline, looking for 401 Unauthorized errors.
config.expected_signal: Requests to /wmcs/admin/ resulting in status_code 401 from users not in the RMS service group, or enumeration of the /certification/ and /licensing/ pipelines.

primitive_config.label: SOAP endpoint enumeration patterns
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name, url_path, status_code, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/wmcs/%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY time DESC
primitive_config.expected: Requests to /wmcs/admin/ resulting in status_code 401 from users not in the RMS service group, or enumeration of the /certification/ and /licensing/ pipelines.

nodes.label: Rare user access to RMS services

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) as hosts_hit, COUNT(*) as request_count, MIN(time) as first_seen FROM hb_http_activity WHERE LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/wmcs/%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name HAVING hosts_hit <= 2 ORDER BY hosts_hit ASC
config.description: Baseline user interaction with the RMS cluster to identify outliers performing discovery.
config.expected_signal: A user account with no history of RMS usage suddenly interacting with RMS endpoints on a small number of servers.

primitive_config.label: Rare user access to RMS services
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) as hosts_hit, COUNT(*) as request_count, MIN(time) as first_seen FROM hb_http_activity WHERE LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/wmcs/%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name HAVING hosts_hit <= 2 ORDER BY hosts_hit ASC
primitive_config.expected: A user account with no history of RMS usage suddenly interacting with RMS endpoints on a small number of servers.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, actor_user_name, COUNT(*) as query_count FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{rms_keywords}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(query_hostname) LIKE '%certification%' OR LOWER(query_hostname) LIKE '%licensing%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname, actor_user_name
config.description: Identify hosts attempting to resolve common RMS-related subdomains or service names, which often precedes SOAP enumeration.
config.expected_signal: DNS resolutions for RMS service names by unexpected user accounts or from non-standard workstations.

config.objective: Determine if any host or user account is systematically enumerating the AD RMS cluster endpoints, specifically looking for access to administrative pipelines or anomalous retrieval of templates.
config.description: Synthesize the results from software inventory, HTTP activity, and DNS discovery to determine if discovery tradecraft is present.
config.expected_signal: A per-user/per-host verdict on whether the activity indicates intentional mapping of the AD RMS deployment.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of malicious | suspicious | benign per actor, citing specific SOAP status codes and query names.

config.question: the triage verdict is malicious for an account enumerating /admin/ paths or rare accounts accessing templates
config.condition: the triage verdict is malicious for an account enumerating /admin/ paths or rare accounts accessing templates
config.description: Route to investigation if malicious activity is found, or close the hunt.
An analyst reviews the authentication and access patterns for the flagged accounts.
config.instructions: Review the identified user accounts. Check hb_auth_signin for successful logons to the RMS servers. Confirm if the user (e.g., 'paulie.gualtieri') has any business reason to be interacting with RMS or if the workstation is a known jump host.

config.description: Close the hunt and update baselines for legitimate RMS users.
